note: #1066: cube axes CASA derives from the selection, start and width (nchan=-1), strided channel selections and cubic spectral interpolation, against CASA 6.7.6.14, with tools/casa-compat/tclean_case_matrix.py. refim_point.ms holds one window of 20 TOPO channels of 50 MHz from 1 GHz; refim_point_withline.ms the same window with a spectral line. Optical-velocity (tabular) axes wait for #1096 and are refused. refim_point_withline_flag9.ms is refim_point_withline.ms with channel 9 flagged in every row by CASA's flagdata(mode='manual', spw='0:9', flagbackup=False); it is made beside the data root's copy, as casatestdata has none.

derived_start_channel.note: nchan=-1 from channel 5 in pairs: seven channels (regridChanBounds with nchan<0)

derived_width_channel.note: nchan=-1, a three-channel width from the first channel: six channels

derived_start_frequency.note: nchan=-1 from 1.2 GHz in 100 MHz channels: eight channels

derived_width_frequency.note: nchan=-1, a negative frequency width and no start: ten channels down from the top

derived_start_velocity.note: nchan=-1 from a radio velocity in 20000 km/s channels: four channels

derived_width_velocity.note: nchan=-1, a radio-velocity width and no start: twelve channels

derived_spw_range.note: nchan=-1 with spw='0:5~12' and no start: the eight selected channels (test_modelvis_8's first call)

derived_spw_range_start.note: nchan=-1 with spw='0:5~12' and start=6: every channel from the seventh to the window's end, fourteen

derived_spw_range_width.note: nchan=-1 with spw='0:5~12' and a 100 MHz width: four channels over the selection

derived_negative_width_from_start_error.note: nchan=-1 with width=-2 and no start: no output channel fits below the first, and CASA's coordinate build fails

strided_default_start.note: a strided selection with nchan=-1: the axis spans channels 4 to 16, the stride selects the data

strided_explicit_axis.note: a strided selection under an explicit axis of four-channel bins

cubic_line.note: interpolation='cubic' on a line dataset, the axis on the data channels

cubic_line_offset.note: interpolation='cubic' half a channel off the data channels

cubic_line_wide.note: interpolation='cubic' onto two-channel bins: CASA's fine frequency grid

cubic_line_briggs.note: interpolation='cubic' with per-channel Briggs weights (the nearer channel's weight)

cubic_line_flagged_channel.note: interpolation='cubic' half a channel off the data with channel 9 flagged: the samples whose four channels hold it fit its stored value and no model there, as CASA's swapyz leaves the flagged model zero

cubic_line_flagged_channel_wide.note: the flagged channel under two-channel bins
